newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Choice Hotels started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Choice Hotels started.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Joyce Minor started coverage of Choice Hotels International Inc with a buy rating.
-- Set earnings estimates of $0.55 per share for calendar 1996, $0.74 per share for calendar 1997 and $0.95 for 1998.
-- Set one-year price target of $20 per share, based on 27 times calendar 1997 estimate, which is "slightly below the median multiple of competitors."
